meta.description: Use this skill for OpenFold3, NVIDIA's BioNeMo NIM microservice for biomolecular structure prediction. Invoke for OpenFold3 or protein, protein-ligand, protein-DNA/RNA, or multi-chain complex prediction with hosted NVIDIA API or local Docker NIM. Covers endpoint choice, auth, request payloads, output artifacts, confidence scores, and local container setup.

key_strengths: Exceptional biomolecular scope: unified interface for proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, and multi-entity complexes (1-32 molecules)
Exemplary preflight pattern: explicit copy instruction with NGC_API_KEY/NVIDIA_API_KEY fallback prevents substitution errors
Comprehensive molecule type documentation: all four types (protein, dna, rna, ligand) with format requirements clearly shown
Strong confidence score guidance: all 5 metrics documented with interpretation (higher pLDDT/pTM/iPTM/confidence, lower pDE)
Clear memory guidance: specific thresholds (1800 residues needs 80GB GPU) for capacity planning

recommendations.title: Add TensorRT vs PyTorch path selection guidance
recommendations.problem: TensorRT vs PyTorch paths mentioned (TensorRT for shorter, PyTorch for longer sequences) but no guidance on how to select or whether user control exists
recommendations.root_cause: Implementation detail surfaced without actionable user control
recommendations.fix: Clarify in Common Limits: 'TensorRT vs PyTorch: NIM auto-selects backend based on sequence length and available resources. No user control via API. For sequences >1000 residues, NIM uses PyTorch path which requires more memory but supports longer inputs. This is automatic and transparent.'

recommendations.title: Add specific guidance for >1800 residue memory exhaustion
recommendations.problem: 1800 residue threshold and 80GB requirement documented but no fallback strategy beyond 'use larger GPU'
recommendations.root_cause: Memory constraint mentioned without practical recovery for users with fixed hardware
recommendations.fix: Expand Troubleshooting memory errors: 'For sequences >1800 residues: (1) reduce diffusion_samples to 1, (2) split complex into domains and predict separately if biologically valid, (3) use local NIM on A100 80GB or H100, or (4) reduce MSA depth to decrease memory footprint. Hosted API has memory limits; use local for very long sequences.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for predictions
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running prediction with same inputs produces identical structures
recommendations.fix: Add to Save And Interpret Output: 'Determinism: OpenFold3 with diffusion_samples=1 is deterministic — same molecules, MSAs, and templates produce identical structures across runs. With diffusion_samples >1, each sample explores different diffusion trajectories for structural diversity. Use samples=1 for reproducible benchmarking.'
